name: ERG Spólka Akcyjna
summary: ERG Spólka Akcyjna, a Polish manufacturing firm, specializes in the production of plastic films, injection-molded goods, and various types of adhesive tapes. Its extensive range of film products includes collective bags designed for packaging and preserving both food items and sanitary goods, alongside bags tailored for diverse uses such as holding coal, sawdust, industrial commodities, domestic appliances, electronic and paper goods, rubber materials, and apparel. Additionally, ERG supplies specialized bag inserts for large 'big-bag' containers; perforated films suitable for packaging bulk materials; integral tapes for pull-string closure bags; protective hoods for palletized merchandise; bags featuring convenient tear-off perforations; small-format breakfast bags; refuse and sanitary waste bags; liners for transport crates; and robust foils engineered for sealing paper, cement, and other granular construction materials. The company's portfolio of injection-molded items encompasses battery enclosures, durable transport containers, components for battery cell discharge, crates for bakery and dairy products, heavy-duty construction pails, refuse bins with hinged covers, and spools for winding various materials. Furthermore, ERG manufactures a selection of tapes, including paper-based masking tapes, self-adhesive printed polypropylene tapes, and general-purpose polypropylene packaging tapes. Its primary clientele spans sectors such as food processing, beverage production, automotive manufacturing, and printing. The company also engages in international export of its merchandise. Established in 1896, ERG Spólka Akcyjna operates from its headquarters in Dabrowa Górnicza, Poland.
